A small badge reads 'Disney Wonderful World of Reading' (partially legible) in the top right corner.
The book appears to be wrapped in clear plastic/shrink film, visible as a sheen and slight wrinkle on the cover surface.

No visible tears, stains, or creases on the front cover itself, but corners and edges are not photographed.
